title: Dou Dizhu
tagline: One landlord. Two farmers. Fifty-four cards.
taglineZh: 一个地主，两个农民，五十四张牌。

lines.en: One landlord. Two farmers. Fifty-four cards.
lines.zh: 一个地主，两个农民，五十四张牌。

lines.en: Dou Dizhu. The family card table.
Deal seventeen each and three bottom cards.
lines.zh: 三家各十七张，三张底牌。

lines.en: Bid one, two or three. The highest call takes the bottom.
lines.zh: 叫 1、2 或 3 分，最高叫分拿底牌。

lines.en: Singles, pairs, straights, airplanes, bombs and rockets.
lines.zh: 单张、对子、顺子、飞机、炸弹和王炸。

lines.en: Two passes reset the trick. Spring doubles the stake.
lines.zh: 两家不出重置牌权，春天再翻一倍。

lines.en: Four honest AI levels, hot-seat privacy, or two phones on one network.
lines.zh: 四档诚实电脑、同屏隐私遮挡，或两台手机连同一网络。

lines.en: Dou Dizhu. Deal the next hand.
